mood: Warm, earthy, community-driven, trustworthy, urgent but not corporate.

rules: Use tight letter spacing for headings.
Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
Labels must be uppercase with wide tracking.
Warm sand background, not pure white for the app wrapper.
Terracotta orange for urgent CTAs and timers.
Deep forest green for secondary buttons and trust indicators.
Never use pure black; use deep olive (#1C221F).
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, warm ambient shadows. No harsh black dropshadows. Example: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(44,85,69,0.08)]
visual_enhancers.borders: Soft borders, 1px solid border with #E8E2D9 for cards.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards. Nested elements should have proportionate radii.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper or grain texture for backgrounds to enhance the 'earthy' feel.

instructions: Use Shadcn primitives but heavily style them.
Bottom Navigation: Fixed bottom, solid background (NO TRANSPARENCY), soft top shadow, icons for Feed, Post, Inbox, Profile.
Floating Action Button (FAB): Use a prominent, pill-shaped primary color button slightly hovering above the bottom nav for the 'Post' action.
Feed Cards (Bento Style): Full width on mobile, large image on top (max-h-48, object-cover). Timer overlaid on image with solid pill background. Condition notes and portions below.
Timers: Visual progress bars or pulsating pills in #E06D53 for expiring soon, #5B8266 for > 2 hours left.
Forms (Post Flow): Multi-step, card-based with clear progression.

layouts.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#F7F4F0] pb-24 relative overflow-x-hidden shadow-2xl
layouts.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Generous padding inside cards.
layouts.grids: Use 1-column stack for mobile feed. 2-column bento for profile stats or filters.

rules: Card entrance: slide up with slight fade in.
Page transitions: smooth horizontal slide for claims/chat.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Contrast check required for text over images. Use solid background or heavy gradient for text overlay on photos.
Focus states: ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#F7F4F0].

instructions_to_main_agent: Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion sonner` to add necessary packages.

Implement a strict Mobile-First PWA container constraint (`max-w-md mx-auto`) so the app looks like a native mobile app even when viewed on a desktop viewport. Wrap the main layout inside a phone-like container wrapper with proper shadowing (`shadow-2xl`).
Use Manrope for all headings and Figtree for body text. Do not use generic fonts like Inter. Import these from Google Fonts.
Avoid default standard Shadcn styling. Adapt the border-radius (`rounded-2xl`, `rounded-3xl`) and colors to match the earthy/warm aesthetic.
In the Nearby Feed, prioritize visual urgency using the Terracotta (#E06D53) color for countdown timers.
DO NOT use a transparent background for the bottom navigation or any top overlays. Always use a solid color like #FFFFFF or #F7F4F0 to ensure readability.
For the map pin feature, mock the map UI with a generic map background or abstract grid with an overlaying pin since real map integration isn't strictly requested.
Ensure the application strictly uses .js file extensions instead of .tsx, since this environment runs on standard JavaScript.
Implement 'data-testid' on ALL interactive buttons, links, and forms.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur), but never pure transparency over content.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner components are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js`.
